scope: The default-deny CapturedReplayTape.v1 codec owned by dskit/production/bundles.py: exact 9-field schema, canonical bytes, and the two recomputed digests (ordered_envelopes_sha256, tape_digest). Self-contained; no capture hierarchy, no composed-tape verification, no multi-consumer capture.
non_goals: compose_replay_tape composed-tape verification seam (slice 2b, blocked on 0164)
multi-consumer capture of one published root
deriving ordered_envelope_digests from a feed (supplied inputs to the codec)
R1-R5 replay machinery; F1/F2 envelope reorder; second planner/ledger/tape engine

schema.name: CapturedReplayTape

fields.name: ordered_envelope_digests
fields.rule: list of lowercase 64-hex sha256 (placeholder/self refused), length == envelope_count

schema.supplied_vs_computed: 2 literal + 5 supplied (data_capture_root, data_captured_receipt, source_rank_policy_sha256, envelope_count, ordered_envelope_digests) + 2 computed = 9 fields total.

construction.opaque: No public constructor; copy/deepcopy/pickle/__reduce__/__reduce_ex__ all refuse (matches existing opaque value doctrine). No attribute mutation.
construction.factory: a private _build(data_capture_root, data_captured_receipt, source_rank_policy_sha256, ordered_envelope_digests) validates all inputs, computes ordered_envelopes_sha256 and tape_digest, returns an immutable CapturedReplayTape. Only this factory (or parse) mints one.
construction.parse: CapturedReplayTape.parse(raw) is the default-deny read side: decode canonical JSON, require exactly the 9 keys (no extra/missing), validate every field, recompute and verify both computed digests, then return the immutable value.
construction.accessors: read-only properties for each of the 9 fields; to_obj(); canonical_bytes().

parse_refusals: schema_version or event_envelope_schema not the exact literal
digest field not a str, not 64 hex, not lowercase, or placeholder '0'*64 or 'self'
ordered_envelope_digests not a list, any element invalid, or length != envelope_count
tape_digest recompute mismatch (incl. tape_digest included in its own source)
positive_grammar: A correct 9-field dict builds and round-trips: parse(canonical_bytes(to_obj())) == value; both computed digests are exact canonical_hash results; envelope_count == len(ordered_envelope_digests).

cases: tape_digest computed over a source that includes tape_digest

compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production (unchanged; codec is production-side); bundles.py imports only dskit.production.base + stdlib.
compatibility.p4_p6: no trust.py change in this slice; P4/P6 capture machinery untouched.
compatibility.replay_tape_abc: the existing ReplayTape ABC in bundles.py is untouched; CapturedReplayTape is a distinct value type, not a ReplayTape subclass.

forbidden_effects: accepting a placeholder/self or noncanonical digest

tests.new: tests/production/test_captured_replay_tape.py: positive build/parse/canonical round-trip; all codec-shape/count/digest/recompute/opacity negative families.

implementation_files: dskit/production/bundles.py (CapturedReplayTape codec; __all__ owns the name per the package's 'each seam module owns its own __all__' convention — no __init__.py re-export)
